note: The root key records the consonants of the place name. Its derivation is uncertain.
summary: Genesis names Gomorrah alongside Sodom, Admah and Zeboiim when describing the boundary of Canaanite territory.

senses.definition: A city named with Sodom in the description of the Canaanite boundary.

evidence.note: The boundary description lists עֲמֹרָה between Sodom and Admah.
